name: Corby Spirit and Wine Limited
summary: Corby Spirit and Wine Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and imports spirits, wines, whiskies, vodkas, rums, liquors, gins, tequilas, bourbons, champagnes, and ready-to-drink cocktails in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Case Goods and Commissions. The company offers its products under the J.P. Wiser's, Lamb's, Polar Ice, McGuinness, Cottage Springs, Nude, Ungava, Chic Choc, Cabot Trail, The Foreign Affair Winery, Absolut, Chivas Regal, The Glenlivet, Ballantine's, Jameson, Beefeater, Malibu, Bumbu, Olmeca, Altos, Jefferson's, Rabbit Hole, Kahlúa, Mumm, Mott's, Clamato, Snapple, Tahiti Treat, Hires, …
